landing.sticker: for people who can't stop adding to cart
landing.heroSubtitle: Tijori locks your money away and gives the key to your best friend.
landing.howItWorksSub: Three simple steps between your impulse and your goal.
landing.step1Desc: Name your goal, set your target amount, and choose when you want to achieve it.
landing.step2Title: We save a little, on schedule
landing.step2Desc: Auto-pulls small amounts from your card on your allowance or salary day before you spend it.
landing.step3Desc: Need to break it early? Write an honest excuse. Your trusted friend decides whether to open it.
landing.approvalHeading: Your friend gets the excuse. Not the money.
landing.approvalStory1: When impulse strikes, you can't just swipe and withdraw.
landing.approvalStory2: You write what you want to buy, and Ahmed gets the notification.
landing.approvalStory3: If he says no, your savings stay locked and your streak survives.
landing.mockupUser: Abdulrahman wants to unlock Japan Summer Trip
landing.mockupExcuse: Found a limited sneaker drop at 360 Mall.
landing.mockupAiNote: Third break request this month. 18-day streak at stake.
landing.rulesHeading: Two ways out. One protects your future.
landing.rulesSub: Your savings stay locked until your target date. If impulse strikes and you truly need to break early, you choose your path:
landing.ruleFriendDesc: Send an honest excuse to your trusted keyholder. If they approve, your safe opens with only a minor 5% discipline fee (you get 95%). If they say NO, 0% is lost and your savings streak survives.
landing.ruleFriendBullet1: Friend approves: 95% returned to your account
landing.ruleFriendBullet2: Friend denies: 0 KWD deducted, streak stays unbroken
landing.ruleSelfDesc: No friend around or too embarrassed to send your excuse? You can force-break the vault yourself anytime—but you surrender a stinging 50% penalty that goes directly to charity.
landing.ruleSelfBullet1: Instant emergency unlock without asking anyone
landing.ruleSelfBullet2: 50% penalty hurts enough to stop impulse spending cold
landing.ruleSelfBullet3: Forces you to think four times before breaking
landing.rulesComparisonNote: Example on a 100 KWD savings goal:
landing.rulesComparisonFriend: Friend says YES: You keep 95 KWD (only 5 KWD fee)
landing.rulesComparisonSelf: Self-Break: You keep 50 KWD (50 KWD lost!)
landing.whySub: Made for how you actually spend.
landing.why1Desc: No sneaky instant withdrawals. Your future self comes first.
landing.why2Desc: Your friend is harder to convince than you are.
landing.why3Desc: Save 5, 25, or 100 KWD weekly or monthly without changing your lifestyle.
landing.why4Desc: Timed for university student allowances and end-of-month paychecks.
